scope: Current post-fix automated verification and regression-test source for restore planning, migration approval, delegation-token handling, SQLite policy, concurrency, and Windows security boundaries.
Persisted race, vet, five-target cross-build, native Windows, acceptance-matrix, release-gate, CI configuration, and publication-governance evidence.
Evidence review only: no full-suite, formatter, linter, build, or source-modifying command was run by this reviewer.

automated_local_proof.details: The current-workspace-post-fix map records 26 automated security/privacy entries as PASS, a race run of 465 tests across 34 packages, clean go vet, and successful cross-builds for darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, linux/arm64, linux/amd64, and windows/amd64. Its filesystem modification time is later than every current Go source/test file inspected.

Restore-plan tests validate checksum, integrity, compatibility, absolute distinct paths, a fresh destination, non-mutation of existing/fresh destinations, and fail-closed corrupt or incompatible backup inspection. The map traces these checks to SEC-T15.

Token tests cover verifier-only persistence, wrong/expired/revoked/reused/wrong-project redemption, a 32-worker one-winner redemption race, fixed-length token detection/redaction including suffixed credentials, and rejection before configuration, foundation-store, resume/adopt, and dependency persistence boundaries. SEC-T06 and SEC-T07 are explicitly mapped to the lineage tests.

SQLite tests exercise foreign keys, busy timeout, WAL eligibility and DELETE fallback, deterministic bounded and cancelable retries, newer/checksum-divergent schema rejection, absent/mismatched/expired/future approval rejection without mutation, exactly-once approval consumption, replay rejection, failed-apply rollback with retained backup, exact URI-significant backup paths, and the v4-to-v5 receipt/audit migration. SEC-T14, SEC-T15, and SEC-T17 are explicitly mapped.

The source contains observable contention and replay tests for a single claim winner, dependency cycle rejection, criterion-driven unblock, and exactly-once notification/reconciliation. SEC-T16 and acceptance rows OMG-AC-005/006 and OMG-CAP-005/008 describe the corresponding behaviors.

windows_native_proof.details: On native Windows/amd64, windowsacl IsPrivate, SQLite secure-state DACL, and watch ACL/reparse/lock/lease focused tests passed. The same run exposed the then-current migration-plan output failure, so its overall FAIL is retained rather than hidden.

The follow-up native build passed focused CLI migration-output, private payload, and non-argv token transport tests; rejected a broad output parent; accepted a private DACL parent; created the plan and backup; and correctly refused migration apply without an approval file.

The latest native lifecycle passed fresh init, private-parent plan creation, backup, bounded approved migration apply, consumed-approval replay rejection, post-apply doctor integrity, and disposable-fixture cleanup. Coordination read/write smoke was explicitly not run and is not represented as covered by this artifact.

ci_only_limitations.details: CI defines Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows vet/race/native lifecycle jobs; native smoke runners for all five required OS/architecture pairs; and a separate five-target cross-build matrix. This local repository has no hosted-run result for the exact current source.

The matrix correctly labels CI-All/platform-wide assertions separately. The canonical gate still has 49 pending external criteria and publication NOT PUBLISHED. final-gate.json and FINAL_REPORT.md predate the post-fix native evidence and still describe native Windows as wholly pending; they are not evidence that the hosted CI-All gate has passed.

human_gated_items.details: OMG-AC-016 and OMG-CAP-015 keep migration or external restore mutation approval-bound; OMG-AC-020 is reviewer-gated; OMG-AC-021 and OMG-RG-003 keep publication NOT PUBLISHED without explicit authorization; OMG-RG-001/002 retain release, identity, legal, and human gate requirements.

The native migration apply used an explicit approval bounded to the exact plan fields and backup checksum with a ten-minute expiry, and replay was rejected. This disposable-fixture approval does not authorize publication, deployment, or any other external mutation.

acceptance_traceability.details: Stable acceptance rows define PIN/RED/GREEN/SURFACE/CLEAN evidence, platform labels, and human gates. The current source-test map links the reviewed token, recovery, claim-race, migration, and SQLite-policy tests to SEC-T06, SEC-T07, SEC-T14, SEC-T15, SEC-T16, and SEC-T17; the capability ledger independently names the corresponding OMG-CAP behaviors.

remaining_risks: Hosted CI has not executed the exact current source, so CI-All and other platform-wide criteria remain publication blockers even though local QA and the available native Windows fixtures pass their stated scope.

The latest native lifecycle did not include a coordination read/write smoke; the configured native Windows CI lifecycle and broader hosted suite remain the required proof for that cross-platform path.

The latest native artifacts are not cryptographically bound to a final current-workspace source archive. Comparison with the 20260723T024823Z native source snapshot found only a behavior-preserving retry-delay extraction in production plus test additions, but exact-source hosted CI and regenerated release evidence remain required before release.

evidence/release/final-gate.json and evidence/release/FINAL_REPORT.md contain older test totals and pre-fix native-Windows status. They must be regenerated and re-pinned before serving as a final release gate; this QA verdict does not amend or override their NOT PUBLISHED disposition.

Sixteen independent-review entries in the current security/privacy source-test map were still PENDING_POST_FIX_REVIEW when inspected; this QA artifact satisfies only the QA review assignment and does not stand in for the other required independent reviewers.
